units.source_text: 刚才还在一旁笑嘻嘻地嘟囔着‘说什么呢’的小姐，不知什么时候已走到房间的角落，背对着我们了。

en.t: The young lady, who had just been beside us laughing and muttering, "What are you talking about?", had somehow gone to the corner of the room and turned her back to us.

units.source_text: 我转过身要走时，看见了小姐的背影，

en.t: When I turned to leave, I saw the young lady from behind,

units.source_text: 只看背影是看不出一个人的内心的，

en.t: but a person's heart cannot be known from their back alone,

units.source_text: 我猜不出小姐对这个问题是怎么想的。

en.t: and I could not guess what the young lady thought about the matter.
The young lady sat in front of the closet,

units.source_text: 从开着一尺多宽的门里取出了什么东西，放在膝上看着。

en.t: took something out through a door opened a little over a foot wide, placed it on her knees, and looked at it.

units.source_text: 从打开的壁橱缝隙，我看见了前天买的衣料。

en.t: Through the gap in the open closet, I saw the cloth we had bought the day before yesterday.

units.source_text: 我的衣服和小姐的一同叠放在壁橱里靠边角的地方。

en.t: My clothes and the young lady's were folded together in a corner of the closet.

units.source_text: 我没说什么，正要离开时，夫人忽然换了郑重的语气，问我是怎么想的。

en.t: I said nothing and was about to leave when the lady suddenly adopted a solemn tone and asked what I thought.

units.source_text: 由于她问得太突然，以至于我不得不反问一句：‘什么怎么想的？’

en.t: Her question came so suddenly that I had to ask back, "What do you mean, what do I think?"

units.source_text: 当我弄清她是问我，让小姐早点出嫁是否合适时，我回答‘还是稳妥些好’。

en.t: When I understood that she was asking whether it would be better to marry the young lady off soon, I answered, "It would be better to be cautious."

units.source_text: 夫人说她也是这个意思。

en.t: The lady said that she thought so too.
